question: Which jurisdictions enacted UCC Article 12, and when does it take effect?
answer: At the saved 2026-09-22 cutoff, 36 of 41 tracked jurisdictions had enacted the amendments and 5 had introduced them without enactment. Effective dates remain separate; state session law controls.
